title: Regularized Least Squares Training of Quadratic Neural Networks with Applications to System Identification
abstract: arXiv:2609.17654v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper proposes a least squares approach for the training of quadratic neural networks with regularization. The proposed methodology yields a lower bound on the solution of the training optimization problem for the case where the regularization coefficient is positive. Moreover, it yields closed-form expressions for the approximate solution and its sensitivity The lower bound is tight and the approximate solution is the optimal solution when the regularization coefficient is zero. Having a closed-form expression for the weights reduces considerably the computational time when compared with iterative numerical methods such as backpropagation that can get stuck in local minima. translated_title: 基于正则化最小二乘的二次神经网络训练及其在系统辨识中的应用
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种带正则化的最小二乘方法用于二次神经网络的训练。所提出的方法在正则化系数为正的情况下，给出了训练优化问题解的下界；此外，还给出了近似解及其灵敏度的闭式表达式。该下界是紧的，且当正则化系数为零时，近似解即为最优解。与反向传播等可能陷入局部极小值的迭代数值方法相比，拥有权重的闭式表达式可大幅减少计算时间。所提出的方法有三大主要贡献：（i）给出了权重的解析表达式；（ii）提供了权重对数据误差敏感度的解析表达式；（iii）建立了……之间的联系（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种正则化最小二乘法训练二次神经网络，可得到权重的闭式解析解及其对数据误差的灵敏度表达式，避免了反向传播易陷入局部极小值的问题并显著降低计算时间。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a regularized least squares approach for training quadratic neural networks, providing closed-form analytical weight expressions and sensitivity analysis, which avoids the local minima issues of backpropagation and significantly reduces computation time.
